question: Which of the following is NOT a component of xylem?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Companion cell**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Companion cells are not a component of xylem**, but are instead a component of phloem tissue:

 
 
• **Xylem**

 
 
• It is a tissue that transports water and nutrients from the roots to other parts of the plant.
 
• It also provides mechanical strength to the plant. Xylem is made up of tracheids, vessels, xylem fibres, and xylem parenchyma.
 
 
 
• **Phloem**
 
 
• A tissue that transports food from the leaves to other parts of the plant.
 
• Phloem is made up of sieve tubes, companion cells, phloem parenchyma, and phloem fibres.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Vessel:
 
 
• Vessels are tube-like structures found in the xylem that help transport water and minerals from roots to other parts of the plant.
 
• They consist of a series of elongated cells called vessel elements, which are connected end-to-end with perforated walls to allow easy flow of water.
 
 
 
• Tracheid:
 
 
• Tracheids are elongated, tube-like cells in the xylem that assist in the conduction of water and provide structural support to the plant.
 
• Unlike vessels, tracheids lack perforated ends but have pits to allow lateral movement of water between cells.
 
 
 
• Parenchyma:
 
 
• Parenchyma cells are living, thin-walled cells that play a role in storage, photosynthesis, and wound healing in plants.
 
• These cells are found throughout the plant body and are also involved in gas exchange and secretion.
